title: Review and moderate submitted feedback
prerequisites: Fictional submitted feedback and a moderator account.

scenes.title: Find the workflow
scenes.narration: Feedback collects submitted messages that need operator attention. Open Feedback and identify the message you intend to review. Read the actual content and context before changing its state.

scenes.title: Understand the controls
scenes.narration: Use the available status controls to represent what your team has done. A status should not imply that the customer received a reply unless that communication actually happened. Keep private contact details out of shared recordings.

scenes.title: Perform the task
scenes.narration: Review the updated item and use pagination to find older submissions. Handle abusive or irrelevant content according to your store's policy. Do not remove a valid report simply because it describes an inconvenient problem.

scenes.title: Verify and continue
scenes.narration: For an order issue, use the order and customer workflows to investigate the underlying facts. Feedback moderation does not change inventory, issue a refund or resolve a shipment. Record operational actions in their proper sections.
